description: Operations executive: two clear themes (manual re-checks, missing documents) and one idea that stands alone.

Payout files are checked twice by hand before release.
Change-of-bank requests arrive without a cancelled cheque and are sent back.
Corporate KYC goes back and forth because documents are missing.
The canteen menu should change every week.
